land._doc: Land cover meshes, one per tile: chunks = [first vertex, vertex count, first index, index count, x0, y0, x1, y1]. verts float32 (x, 0, y); cols float32 RGBA (g = kind / 255, b = variant / 255); idx int32 (per tile, from its first vertex). Each zlib then base64, *_bytes = size unpacked.
